schema.description: One way the outside world can tell this estate what exists, what changed, what is hot, what is nearby, what is available and what may be acted on. A census row is not an integration: it names a source family or a concrete source, what kind of access it offers, and — where the estate has actually observed it — the twin holding the receipt and the contract for reading what came back. Most rows are declared and unobserved on purpose; the census is the map, and a pack decides which tiny portion matters. Each concrete source carries a hydration tier and a cadence: reheating is scheduled against pressure rather than crawled on a clock, so a source nobody's closure needs falls to cold and then stops being read at all. A media-bearing source also carries where the picture is: kind (video, image, post, text), the field holding the thumbnail, the origin to resolve a relative one against, the field holding the link out, and the field naming who made it. A wall that has to know that PeerTube calls it thumbnailPath and Lemmy calls it thumbnail_url is a wall with the outside world compiled into it. front_door records whether this estate puts a source on its own public landing page. A source can be worth reading and still not be worth putting in front of a stranger: an unmoderated general feed is a fact about that feed, and declining to feature it is this estate's decision about its own front door rather than a claim about the source. A source that knows more about each thing says where: what it says at length (summary_field), who made it (maker_field), the terms it may be reused under and where those terms are written (rights_field, rights_link_field), the file that plays (media_field), the identity it shares with the same thing elsewhere (ident_field), where it is (place_field) and how a relative link resolves (link_base). Terms are what the source states; they are read and credited, never granted by this estate. A source that needs a key names the credential provider (credential); the key itself lives only in the credential boundary, and a read waits rather than fails while none is set. A source compiled rather than authored names what compiled it (compiled_by), and a source that is one organization's own voice names that organization's identity and name (publisher_ident, publisher_name) so its posts join that organization's page.

One thing a community is trying to bring into being, with every facet it needs at once: what is being built, what it would cost to run, what is still needed in people and in money, what has been decided, and what it becomes afterwards. A project is not a campaign that ends when a target is reached; the target is a stage in a life that continues as a living publication. Nothing recorded here is money held, promised, owed, or authorized to spend.

A marketplace listing this estate observed in a retained public source. It records the listing as observed without asserting inventory, availability, price, merchant authority, checkout, settlement, or a right for this estate to transact.

schema.description: A human social body around one addressed subject. Federation, protocol topology and source reachability are projections around the body, not the body itself.
The explicit relation between a human subject and a community body. Membership state can shape presentation, but does not itself grant effect authority outside the community owner's rules.
A human-authored social occurrence inside a community body. A post may reference media or another post, but neither federation carriage nor observation of bytes creates a post.
A voluntarily disclosed, expiring presence of a community member on one community surface. It is neither membership nor authority, and absence of a record says nothing about a person.
A bounded human reaction relation on a community post. It records the relation the owner accepted; a button press or local optimistic state is not itself a reaction.

One resource the outside world publishes, as compiled into the external estate index. This is a catalogue of what exists, not a map of ways in and not a claim that anything was read: most entries are specifications, repositories and documentation, which are citations rather than sources. A census row may cite one of these; the two are kept apart because conflating what exists with what this estate reads is how a map becomes an integration list.

What a community concluded about a proposal, and on what evidence. A decision is what a group settled; it is not evidence that anything was carried out, and the receipt reference it carries is a digest of something presented rather than proof that value moved.

Something a community is being asked, bound to the verb grammar this estate publishes. A proposal is a question recorded: it is never a decision taken, never authority to act on it, and never evidence that anything was carried out. The backing names what would carry it if it were decided; a backing that cannot settle can never produce an effect outside this estate, and one that can is still gated by the world its institution declares.
Publication/grouping identity for recordings presented as one release. Sequence is owned by music_release_track; commerce is owned by offers/listings; rights and credits remain separate relations.

The identity of an addressed behaviour, separate from any version of it. A pack is not a subject, an institution, an internet cut or a surface; keeping it a fifth thing is what lets a community fork behaviour without forking Bonfyre, and stops behaviour from becoming a second identity that could grant itself authority.
A pack refers to shared bases rather than containing copies of them. Five community packs over one motorcycle base are one base and five tiny overlays, not five expanded applications.

One thing a community is trying to bring into being, with every facet it needs at once: what is being built, what it would cost to run, what is still needed in people and in money, what has been decided, and what it becomes afterwards. A project is not a campaign that ends when a target is reached; the target is a stage in a life that continues as a living publication. Nothing recorded here is money held, promised, owed, or authorized to spend.

One ordered heterogeneous presentation fragment inside an addressed World. It points at semantic material owned elsewhere and declares only how that material is projected here. A fragment does not own subject truth, actor identity, authority, provider admission, payment authority, or an effect.

schema.description: One publisher a set's criteria were run against, with the verdict and which criterion decided it. A machine may record that criteria matched or missed; only a named person moves a candidate to accepted or rejected, because the criteria compute what is reachable and stop at the human line. A matched candidate has not been read, asked for, or endorsed.

One way the outside world can tell this estate what exists, what changed, what is hot, what is nearby, what is available and what may be acted on. A census row is not an integration: it names a source family or a concrete source, what kind of access it offers, and — where the estate has actually observed it — the twin holding the receipt and the contract for reading what came back. Most rows are declared and unobserved on purpose; the census is the map, and a pack decides which tiny portion matters. Each concrete source carries a hydration tier and a cadence: reheating is scheduled against pressure rather than crawled on a clock, so a source nobody's closure needs falls to cold and then stops being read at all. A media-bearing source also carries where the picture is: kind (video, image, post, text), the field holding the thumbnail, the origin to resolve a relative one against, the field holding the link out, and the field naming who made it. A wall that has to know that PeerTube calls it thumbnailPath and Lemmy calls it thumbnail_url is a wall with the outside world compiled into it. front_door records whether this estate puts a source on its own public landing page. A source can be worth reading and still not be worth putting in front of a stranger: an unmoderated general feed is a fact about that feed, and declining to feature it is this estate's decision about its own front door rather than a claim about the source. A source that knows more about each thing says where: what it says at length (summary_field), who made it (maker_field), the terms it may be reused under and where those terms are written (rights_field, rights_link_field), the file that plays (media_field), the identity it shares with the same thing elsewhere (ident_field), where it is (place_field) and how a relative link resolves (link_base). Terms are what the source states; they are read and credited, never granted by this estate. A source that needs a key names the credential provider (credential); the key itself lives only in the credential boundary, and a read waits rather than fails while none is set. A source compiled rather than authored names what compiled it (compiled_by), and a source that is one organization's own voice names that organization's identity and name (publisher_ident, publisher_name) so its posts join that organization's page.

Presentation manifest that binds an addressed subject to playable audio/video material, chapters, transcript/captions and semantic-time tracks. It is a representation contract, not the identity of the Work/Recording/Release and not playback state.

Canonical identity for one recorded performance/fixation of a Music Work. The Recording may reference a master asset but does not become a Release, Track position, credit statement, right, offer or playback session.
Publication/grouping identity for recordings presented as one release. Sequence is owned by music_release_track; commerce is owned by offers/listings; rights and credits remain separate relations.
Canonical identity for an authored musical composition. A Work is not a recording, master, release, offer, performance, credit or right; those remain separate addressed subjects and relations.

The identity of an addressed behaviour, separate from any version of it. A pack is not a subject, an institution, an internet cut or a surface; keeping it a fifth thing is what lets a community fork behaviour without forking Bonfyre, and stops behaviour from becoming a second identity that could grant itself authority.
A pack refers to shared bases rather than containing copies of them. Five community packs over one motorcycle base are one base and five tiny overlays, not five expanded applications.
A mutable pointer from a channel to one immutable version. Publishing is not making official and advancing a head is not installing: a head advances only under the rule its artifact declared.
An institution or actor holds this pack. Holding is not running it: a fork is not an install, an install is not an activation, and an activation is not an authorization.

One retained, observed foreign publication item promoted from a lawful ForeignTwin body. It records the foreign assertion and receipt without turning the observing estate into author, publisher, rights holder, or endorser.

A person's private, reversible reference to something they chose to keep, with the public description its source gave at the time. It lets a kept thing outlive its source's latest feed slot. It is not a copy of the source's material, an endorsement, a claim about the thing, or a grant of anything.

One way the outside world can tell this estate what exists, what changed, what is hot, what is nearby, what is available and what may be acted on. A census row is not an integration: it names a source family or a concrete source, what kind of access it offers, and — where the estate has actually observed it — the twin holding the receipt and the contract for reading what came back. Most rows are declared and unobserved on purpose; the census is the map, and a pack decides which tiny portion matters. Each concrete source carries a hydration tier and a cadence: reheating is scheduled against pressure rather than crawled on a clock, so a source nobody's closure needs falls to cold and then stops being read at all. A media-bearing source also carries where the picture is: kind (video, image, post, text), the field holding the thumbnail, the origin to resolve a relative one against, the field holding the link out, and the field naming who made it. A wall that has to know that PeerTube calls it thumbnailPath and Lemmy calls it thumbnail_url is a wall with the outside world compiled into it. front_door records whether this estate puts a source on its own public landing page. A source can be worth reading and still not be worth putting in front of a stranger: an unmoderated general feed is a fact about that feed, and declining to feature it is this estate's decision about its own front door rather than a claim about the source. A source that knows more about each thing says where: what it says at length (summary_field), who made it (maker_field), the terms it may be reused under and where those terms are written (rights_field, rights_link_field), the file that plays (media_field), the identity it shares with the same thing elsewhere (ident_field), where it is (place_field) and how a relative link resolves (link_base). Terms are what the source states; they are read and credited, never granted by this estate. A source that needs a key names the credential provider (credential); the key itself lives only in the credential boundary, and a read waits rather than fails while none is set. A source compiled rather than authored names what compiled it (compiled_by), and a source that is one organization's own voice names that organization's identity and name (publisher_ident, publisher_name) so its posts join that organization's page.

A session somebody says is happening, the heartbeats that keep it live, and what it points at for replay once it ends. No media flows through this estate. A live session is not an audience, not a viewer count, and not a claim anybody is watching.

One thing a community is trying to bring into being, with every facet it needs at once: what is being built, what it would cost to run, what is still needed in people and in money, what has been decided, and what it becomes afterwards. A project is not a campaign that ends when a target is reached; the target is a stage in a life that continues as a living publication. Nothing recorded here is money held, promised, owed, or authorized to spend.

schema.description: A closed, reproducible measurement of a studied visual language. It records the presentation vector that a renderer may select; it is neither imported theme code nor a claim about the semantic material being rendered.

The people who share a life and therefore a calendar, a set of bills and a school run. A household is composed for the people in it and is not shared by existing: what it holds is read by its own members and by nobody else, including this estate's operators.

A relationship one household has established with one institution, and the single plane it opens. A connection is granted by the institution to that household: it makes a plane readable for them alone, never for this estate, never for other households, and never for anyone reading the institution's public page. Establishing it is not a claim the institution agreed; it is a claim the household says it holds, recorded with who said so and when, and it is revocable by the household at any time.

One way the outside world can tell this estate what exists, what changed, what is hot, what is nearby, what is available and what may be acted on. A census row is not an integration: it names a source family or a concrete source, what kind of access it offers, and — where the estate has actually observed it — the twin holding the receipt and the contract for reading what came back. Most rows are declared and unobserved on purpose; the census is the map, and a pack decides which tiny portion matters. Each concrete source carries a hydration tier and a cadence: reheating is scheduled against pressure rather than crawled on a clock, so a source nobody's closure needs falls to cold and then stops being read at all. A media-bearing source also carries where the picture is: kind (video, image, post, text), the field holding the thumbnail, the origin to resolve a relative one against, the field holding the link out, and the field naming who made it. A wall that has to know that PeerTube calls it thumbnailPath and Lemmy calls it thumbnail_url is a wall with the outside world compiled into it. front_door records whether this estate puts a source on its own public landing page. A source can be worth reading and still not be worth putting in front of a stranger: an unmoderated general feed is a fact about that feed, and declining to feature it is this estate's decision about its own front door rather than a claim about the source. A source that knows more about each thing says where: what it says at length (summary_field), who made it (maker_field), the terms it may be reused under and where those terms are written (rights_field, rights_link_field), the file that plays (media_field), the identity it shares with the same thing elsewhere (ident_field), where it is (place_field) and how a relative link resolves (link_base). Terms are what the source states; they are read and credited, never granted by this estate. A source that needs a key names the credential provider (credential); the key itself lives only in the credential boundary, and a read waits rather than fails while none is set. A source compiled rather than authored names what compiled it (compiled_by), and a source that is one organization's own voice names that organization's identity and name (publisher_ident, publisher_name) so its posts join that organization's page.

A presentation-only composition profile over SurfaceIR. It may choose renderer mix, layout density, typography/media/navigation/card/hero policy and responsive tokens, but it reads no semantic owner, grants no authority and owns no subject state. reference_* fields record where a visual language was studied; provenance is not an implementation dependency or a claim that third-party theme code is installed.

A person's private, reversible reference to something they chose to keep, with the public description its source gave at the time. It lets a kept thing outlive its source's latest feed slot. It is not a copy of the source's material, an endorsement, a claim about the thing, or a grant of anything.

One ordered heterogeneous presentation fragment inside an addressed World. It points at semantic material owned elsewhere and declares only how that material is projected here. A fragment does not own subject truth, actor identity, authority, provider admission, payment authority, or an effect.

schema.description: One person's recorded assent to one exact digest. It is bound to the bytes, so it reports as broken the moment they hash differently. It is not a legal signature, not notarised, not identity verification, and not evidence the signer read what they assented to.
The executable carrier program beneath a typed human action. x402, MCP, Beckn, OpenAPI and similar carriers may compete here, but they never become the user-facing application or grant authority.
A human social body around one addressed subject. Federation, protocol topology and source reachability are projections around the body, not the body itself.
The explicit relation between a human subject and a community body. Membership state can shape presentation, but does not itself grant effect authority outside the community owner's rules.
A human-authored social occurrence inside a community body. A post may reference media or another post, but neither federation carriage nor observation of bytes creates a post.
A voluntarily disclosed, expiring presence of a community member on one community surface. It is neither membership nor authority, and absence of a record says nothing about a person.
A bounded human reaction relation on a community post. It records the relation the owner accepted; a button press or local optimistic state is not itself a reaction.

One retained observation held back from ordinary projection until its presentation state is resolved. This is an observation state, not a moderation verdict and not a moderation product. Flagged does not mean illegal, false, malicious, or deleted, and not flagged does not mean safe: it means only that this material must not be projected automatically into ordinary human surfaces until somebody has decided how it should appear. The observation, its receipt and its bytes are untouched.

One publisher a set's criteria were run against, with the verdict and which criterion decided it. A machine may record that criteria matched or missed; only a named person moves a candidate to accepted or rejected, because the criteria compute what is reachable and stop at the human line. A matched candidate has not been read, asked for, or endorsed.

A working set over observed sources, defined by criteria that run rather than by a list somebody typed. The criteria propose candidates; a person accepts or rejects them. A set is never a claim that its members are related in the world, never permission to fetch or contact anything, and never semantic relevance: every criterion is a filter over facts this estate already recorded.
One executable transition in a human experience graph. A stage is a typed application with material/capability inputs and honest empty/refused states, never an ordered prose chain.

One member's position on one proposal. A vote is what was said by the person who said it: it is never the membership's view, never a decision, and never authority to carry anything out. A member may hold only one position on a proposal at a time; changing it replaces the old one rather than adding to a tally.

A session somebody says is happening, the heartbeats that keep it live, and what it points at for replay once it ends. No media flows through this estate. A live session is not an audience, not a viewer count, and not a claim anybody is watching.

Evidence-backed attribution relating a person or institution to a Work, Recording, Release or performance subject. A credit is attribution, not identity, employment, ownership, royalty share or legal right.

Authored ObjectGrammar contract describing what may be born or attached beneath an addressed closure and which human variables remain unresolved. Rendering an aperture never authorizes its effect; Authority is rechecked by the native owner at submit time.

Something composed for somebody and held. This estate has no transport and none of this record's states claims one: reachability stops before anything leaves, so a message here is written, withheld, handed to a person, or abandoned, and never sent, delivered, or known to its recipient.
This installed pack is running for this actor in this scope. Activation contributes behaviour to a closure and grants nothing: every effect it offers still meets Authority at effect time.
An institution or actor holds this pack. Holding is not running it: a fork is not an install, an install is not an activation, and an activation is not an authorization.

One subject actually running one program template. It exists only when a real institution or person uses the program, and it owns nothing itself: the material, work, evidence and funding stay with the owners that already hold them. An instance is not authority to act, not a funded award, and not a claim that the owning subject has any relationship with any funder.

A generalized capability an institution or person may run, declared once. It names the subject kinds, slots, capability families and existing owners a program of this kind needs. A template is a declaration of what such a program would require; it is never a claim that anyone is running it, that funding exists, or that this estate has any relationship with the funder it names.

A person's stated intention to support a project, recorded before any money moves and independent of whether it ever does. Support recorded here is an intention and a relationship: it is never a payment, never a pledge this estate can collect, and never evidence that value moved. Money movement belongs to a payment rail and leaves a receipt reference, which is a digest of something presented rather than proof of settlement.

A person's private, reversible reference to something they chose to keep, with the public description its source gave at the time. It lets a kept thing outlive its source's latest feed slot. It is not a copy of the source's material, an endorsement, a claim about the thing, or a grant of anything.
Authored institution navigation consumed by human pages and safe speculation candidates. A navigation row names a route; it grants no authority over that route.

Authored page composition for a governed WebAddress route. Copy and arrangement live here; live lenses and action apertures remain owned by their native organs. A published authored page may replace its compiled human fallback but never displaces a declared machine contract.

The executable composition plan for one SitePresentation. It joins declared human ExperiencePrograms, typed application bindings, portable renderer preferences, reagent collections and capability programs. Subject, territory and Ghost profile remain owned by SitePresentation so this row cannot duplicate or drift semantic identity or art direction.

Declarative SurfaceIR read descriptor compiled into symmetric human and machine projections. It may name a CMS type or an allowlisted native organ, select and order fields, and declare read authority; it cannot declare an effect or choose an executable path. A pattern may declare one affordance per record -- an href template whose {field} placeholders name columns it already serves, and a label -- so a reader can act on a row without the page growing a renderer to build the link. Only served fields may appear; a placeholder naming anything else drops the affordance rather than emitting a link with a hole in it.

A human interaction grammar, separated from what it happens to be reading. Route, SurfacePattern, renderer and data source were one thing; a renderer is the third of those on its own, so the same masonry, the same stream-to-topic keyboard, the same faceted compare tray can project a different owner without being rebuilt. A renderer renders; it reads nothing and authorizes nothing.

Generated presentation closure for one addressed subject/site/World and actor presentation scope. It composes existing World, SiteProgram, fragments, slots, bindings, stages, renderers, patterns, ObjectContracts and interaction profile by reference. It owns no underlying material, identity, authority, price, availability, proof, commitment, presence, target state or effect; request-time owners must answer those facts again.

A role a project still needs a person for. A need is what a project says it lacks; it is never an offer of employment, never a contract, and never a claim that anyone has been engaged or will be paid.

One ordered heterogeneous presentation fragment inside an addressed World. It points at semantic material owned elsewhere and declares only how that material is projected here. A fragment does not own subject truth, actor identity, authority, provider admission, payment authority, or an effect.

One subject actually running one program template.
